related.title: NuSTAR 高能 X 射線望遠鏡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付好時間區間、事件數、曝光及門檻敏感度，不只一張清理後圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver good-time intervals,counts,exposure and cut sensitivity,not only a cleaned image.
related.difference: 用長焦距光學教學模型換算結構橫向位移成角誤差，規劃熱變形量測。
related.differenceEn: Convert lateral structural displacement into angular error in a long-focus teaching model and plan thermal-deformation metrology.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 刪第三段後同時重算事件和秒數，與錯用 400 s 的結果比較。
將 0.5 mm 轉公尺，再除焦距和換角秒，與幾何斜率核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remove the third bin and recompute counts and seconds,comparing with the wrong 400 s denominator.
Convert 0.5 mm to metres,divide by focal length and convert to arcseconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Galileo 木星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付好時間區間、事件數、曝光及門檻敏感度，不只一張清理後圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver good-time intervals,counts,exposure and cut sensitivity,not only a cleaned image.
related.difference: 在低資料率模型中估算影像回傳時間，區分壓縮比、資料品質與通訊效率。
related.differenceEn: Estimate image downlink time in a low-rate model while distinguishing compression,quality and link efficiency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 刪第三段後同時重算事件和秒數，與錯用 400 s 的結果比較。
先把 10 MB 轉 80 Mbit，再除 160 bit/s，換成日。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remove the third bin and recompute counts and seconds,comparing with the wrong 400 s denominator.
Convert 10 MB to 80 Mbit,divide by 160 bit/s and convert to days.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
